about: The collecta of the formulary “Mass of the First Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal. This formulary serves the weekdays of that week. On the Sunday itself the feast of the Holy Family takes its place.

seg.tr: We beseech Thee, O Lord, pursue with heavenly loving-kindness the desires of Thy suppliant people, that they may both see what ought to be done and gain strength to fulfill what they have seen. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
